mapper.select: select r.id, r.group_id, r.module_code, r.review_process, r.ai_score, r.similarity, r.model_name, r.teacher_score, r.teacher_checked, r.checked_by, r.review_time, mss.score as module_score from te_ai_review r left join te_group g on g.id = r.group_id left join te_module_score_set mss on mss.class_id = g.class_id and mss.module_code = r.module_code where r.group_id = #{groupId} order by r.module_code
mapper.insert:
insert into te_ai_review (group_id, module_code, review_process, ai_score, similarity, model_name, teacher_score, teacher_checked, checked_by, review_time) values
(#{item.groupId}, #{item.moduleCode}, #{item.reviewProcess}, #{item.aiScore}, #{item.similarity}, #{item.modelName}, #{item.teacherScore}, #{item.teacherChecked}, #{item.checkedBy}, #{item.reviewTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from te_ai_review where group_id = #{groupId}
